PREFERENCES & BACKUP

Settings

Your attendance data stays in this browser unless you export it.

Attendance target

Warning thresholds: below 75% is WARNING; below 60% is DANGER. Your target is editable separately.

Backup and reports

Export a JSON backup to preserve your full data. CSV is useful for spreadsheets.

Storage information

AttendAI saves data in local browser storage on this device. It does not sync to other phones automatically. Clearing browser/site data can erase records. Export backups regularly.

About this version

AttendAI v3 · Offline-friendly static web app · No account or server required for attendance tracking.
